note: Case geography for the map view (GridSim reads case-level geography.json from 2.1.003).

projection.formula: x = m + (1-2m)*(lon-west)/(east-west); y = m + (1-2m)*(lat-south)/(north-south); clamped to [0,1]; north is y=1 (drawn at 1-y on screen)
projection.note: NEM box S 44.0, W 128.8, N 9.0 (south), E 154.0 (regions.json 'australia-spine' nem), margin 0.03: QLD, NSW, ACT, VIC, SA and Tasmania (outline only) with padding; Lord Howe Island and the Coral Sea territories fall outside and are clipped

land.name: Australia (Queensland, New South Wales, Australian Capital Territory, Victoria, South Australia, Tasmania)

sources.title: ABS ASGS Edition 3 (2021) States and Territories, generalised (ArcGIS service, maxAllowableOffset 0.005 deg)
